identificationModule.briefTitle: Trial of Docetaxel-samarium in Patients With Hormone-refractory Advanced Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Prospective Phase II Trial of Docetaxel-samarium in Patients With Hormone-refractory Advanced Prostate Cancer Who Achieve a Response or a Stabilization to Docetaxel-estramustine

leadSponsor.name: Gustave Roussy, Cancer Campus, Grand Paris

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a prospective phase II trial of docetaxel-samarium in patients with hormone-refractory advanced prostate cancer who achieve a response or a stabilization to docetaxel-estramustine.

keywords: hormone-refractory advanced prostate cancer who achieve a response or a stabilization to docetaxel-estramustine

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients older than 18 years and less than 80 years
* Histologically-proven adenocarcinoma of the prostate
* Evidence of bone metastases and progressive, hormone-refractory, disease
* No previous chemotherapy
* No previous radiotherapy, except radiotherapy directed to the prostate and/or to a single bony lesion
* No previous carcinoma, except basal-cell carcinoma of the skin
* Adequate renal function: measured or calculated creatinine clearance \> 60 ml/min
* Absolute granulocyte count ≥ 1,500/mm3, platelets ≥ 100,000 mm3, bilirubin ≤ 1.5 fold the upper normal value
* Signed informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients infected by the Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV)
* Patients who do not fit inclusion criteria
